description:
“Health is Wealth” – Inclusion & Integration Workshop

On 6 Sept, a fun-filled “Health is Wealth” workshop was organised at Sukkur Bhavan, Wadala, for 75 ex-students of SEC with physical and multiple disabilities and their caregivers from economically disadvantaged backgrounds.

The programme focused on holistic health, well-being and social inclusion. A lively Tambola activity with exciting prizes, conducted by Rtn Dr. Sangeeta Agrawal, brought joy and encouraged social interaction.

Participants also received valuable information on healthcare schemes. Mr. Sadanand Pagare explained Ayushman Bharat–PM-JAY and its cashless hospitalisation coverage of up to ₹5 lakh per family annually. Mr. Ratish Bansode, CDO, EIRCC, Nair Hospital, explained the Niramaya Health Insurance Scheme and its benefits for persons with disabilities.

The program was attended by Rtn PP Manju Uttamchandani, Rtn Prakash Chawla and Rtn Dr. Sangeeta Agrawal.

Beneficiaries: 75
Project Cost: Rs 45,000
